channel.title: Glance
channel.description: New versions of Glance, read by Check for Updates…

item.title: Glance 0.2.0
item.description:
Tray

  • Added the tray: files dropped on the notch, and what you copy, newest first.
  • Added clipboard history, kept for 30 minutes, 8 hours or 7 days, never keeping passwords.
  • Added screenshots to the tray, as soon as each is saved.
  • Added AirDrop beside the tray while something's dragged onto the notch.
  • Added link previews to the tray, with each site's icon, fetched from the site's home page rather than the link itself.
  • Added selecting items as Finder does: a click, ⌘-click for more, and Shift-click for a run.
  • Added Quick Look and Share, with AirDrop in it, to each item's menu in the tray.
  • Added the tray fitting its items on the player's padding, growing wider with what's in it from three items up to six with the next one peeking in, then scrolling, with two fingers or a mouse's wheel.
  • Added a page of its first words for copied text, and where a link goes under its site's name, so no two items look alike.
  • Added ⌘Z to bring back what was removed from the tray, for a minute.
  • Added holding what's copied while the pointer is on the tray, so the row never moves under it.
  • Added Keep to an item's menu, so a copy or screenshot stays until removed, marked with a pin.
  • Added Open With to an item's menu, listing the apps that open it.
  • Added Paste and Match Style to an item's menu, with Option held, to paste text without its style.
  • Added typing an item's name to select it, as in Finder.
  • Added a list in Settings of apps whose copies the tray never keeps.
  • Added Glance Tray to the Services menu, in Finder and every other app.
  • Added Glance Tray to the Share menu, for pictures, links, text and files from Safari, Photos, Finder and every other app that shares.
  • Added a Tray page to Settings, and a step for the tray to the welcome tour.

Opening

  • Added ⇧⌘1 to open and close the player from any app, ahead of the app's own shortcuts.
  • Added ⇧⌘2 to open and close the tray the same way.
  • Added three fingers on the open notch, or Shift and a scroll, to switch between the player and the tray, either way round.
  • Added opening the tray when something is dragged near the notch and held there a moment.
  • Added keyboard shortcut settings in Settings > Opening to change them.
  • Added the keyboard to the notch opened with a shortcut, or after a click in the tray: Escape, the arrows, Space and Return, and ⌘C, ⌘A, ⌘Delete and ⌘Z on the tray.

Accessibility

  • Made the notch opaque while Increase Contrast is on, with the player on plain black.
  • Made covers and their colors hold still, and long titles stop scrolling, while Reduce Motion is on.
  • Added names for VoiceOver and Voice Control to the player's buttons and progress bar, and actions to the tray's items.
  • Dimmed clear glass by a third, so the player's times and buttons read over light windows.
  • Made a new song's name, in the cover's color, light enough to read on the black notch.
  • Dimmed the glass further on the tray, so the items' names read over light windows.
  • Made the tray's items fade in and out, and the player and the tray swap with a fade, while Reduce Motion is on.

Additional

  • Added Undo, Redo, Delete, Zoom, Bring All to Front and Services to the menu bar, and moved Close to a File menu.
  • Added two scenes to the welcome tour's pictures: the player turning between its two layouts until you choose one, and a photo dragged to the notch and dropped in the tray.

item.title: Glance 0.1.0
item.description:
Player

  • Added Now Playing in the notch, with customizable controls.
  • Added two layouts, Cover on top and Cover on the side, and four backgrounds behind the player: Replace glass, Fullscreen, Spotlight, and None.
  • Added Liquid Glass with adjustable darkness and blur, or the style set in System Settings, tinted by the cover or by the Mac's accent color.
  • Added animated album covers from Apple Music, for songs playing in any app.

Live Activities

  • Added the cover and a waveform around the closed notch while something plays.
  • Added a short announcement when something starts playing.

Lyrics

  • Added timed lyrics from LRCLIB beside the player.

Opening

  • Added opening by hover, click, or either, each with an optional delay.
  • Added two-finger swipes to open and close the notch and to change songs.
  • Added an optional haptic tap when the notch opens.

Displays

  • Added a notch or a Dynamic Island on displays without one.
  • Added settings for where the notch shows, and for hiding it in full screen.
  • Made the notch stay over the camera while swiping between desktops and full-screen apps.

Additional

  • Added a Settings window.
  • Added a welcome tour on first launch.
  • Added Check for Updates… and automatic updates from Glance's GitHub releases, through Sparkle.
